description:
Overview

Soft Brushed Fabric: Offers a gentle, comfortable feel against the skin.

Fold-Over Waistband: Provides a customizable and flattering fit.

Moisture-Wicking: Effectively absorbs sweat to keep you dry during activities.

Wide-Leg Design: Features a relaxed, trendy silhouette that allows for free movement.

Slimming Effect: Creates a visually elongated and slender leg line.

Versatile Performance: Ideal for running, yoga, cycling, and everyday leisure.

 

Specifications

Material: 78% Nylon, 22% Spandex

Pants Length: Long Pants

Waist Type: Low-Rise

Pants Style: Wide Leg Pants

Lining: None

Size Range: S, M, L, XL

Error Range: 1-4cm

Color Options: Cream apricot, Mist charcoal gray, Olive green, Berry rose, Raspberry red, Black coffee, Badge blue, Moss green, High-end black, Eggplant purple, Phantom blue, Falling cherry blossom powder, Lilac purple

Women brushed pants*1
